messages:
zoe_docs: quick sync 12 adding a short 'tenant migration' blurb to the SOC2/audit-logs page. want to confirm snippets + legal phrasing before i open the PR.
alan_sec: prefer 'tenant migration' term. call out that legal holds block ttl expiry and exports are customer's responsibility. :lock:
marco_eng: sdk v2 names: use `set_retention_policy` and `holds.create`. holds.create returns an id and prevents deletion until released.
zoe_docs: draft python snippet (please check):
```
from redwood import AuditClient, HoldsClient
ac = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
ac.set_retention_policy(tenant_id="acct_777", ttl_days=90)
hold = HoldsClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY").create(tenant_id="acct_777", reason="contract review")
print(hold.id)
```

zoe_docs: and a tiny curl export example with optional redaction:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct_777","from":"2025-04-01","to":"2025-04-30","redact_sensitive":true}'
```

emma_legal: suggested line: "During tenant migration, audit logs follow the tenant's configured retention policy unless a legal hold is applied; exports created by the customer remain their responsibility and must be secured per contract."
link-bot: link-checker: found 1 missing anchor in docs/security page.
zoe_docs: i'll fix the anchor and open PR after link check. assigning reviewers @alan_sec @emma_legal @marco_eng. PR will include a short FAQ bullet: retention follows tenant policy, legal holds override TTL, exports are customer's responsibility. last_message_ts: 1767000180
